No established antipsychotic treatment is documented. Discuss treatment context and preferences; this question does not select an initial medication. Distribution: {OralAntipsychoticMedication}. DDI remains a separate report.

Candidate response-review category: review target symptoms, elapsed interval and possible contributors; do not infer treatment failure or change medication automatically. Distribution: {SymptomResponse}. DDI remains a separate report.

Candidate partial-response category: discuss remaining symptoms and functioning with the clinician; timing and uncertainty remain explicit. Distribution: {SymptomResponse}. DDI remains a separate report.

Candidate adequate-response category: review observed target symptoms and functioning; the distribution does not prescribe continuation. Distribution: {SymptomResponse}. DDI remains a separate report.
No established treatment response can be assessed; this is distinct from inadequate or absent response. Distribution: {SymptomResponse}. DDI remains a separate report.
Review the context and baseline used to judge functional change; no automatic medication decision. Distribution: {FunctionalBenefit}. DDI remains a separate report.
Discuss the assessed functional benefit alongside symptoms, preferences and adverse effects. Distribution: {FunctionalBenefit}. DDI remains a separate report.
Treatment-related functional benefit is not assessable without established treatment; no negative finding is inferred. Distribution: {FunctionalBenefit}. DDI remains a separate report.

The experimental absent-side-effect category is a probability topic, not a confirmed patient negative; review documented tolerability. Distribution: {SignificantAntipsychoticSideEffects}. DDI remains a separate report.

Discuss documented side effects and their impact with the clinician; this probability topic does not diagnose an effect or choose a drug. Distribution: {SignificantAntipsychoticSideEffects}. DDI remains a separate report.

Established-treatment side effects are not assessable in this context; this does not mean side effects were assessed and absent. Distribution: {SignificantAntipsychoticSideEffects}. DDI remains a separate report.
Experimental response-review signal not triggered; retain uncertainty and ongoing clinician review. Distribution: {ResponseReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.

Discuss response and potential contributors with the clinician; do not equate this signal with treatment failure or initiate a medication change. Distribution: {ResponseReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Established-treatment response-review signal is not assessable without established treatment; discuss treatment context. Distribution: {ResponseReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.

Experimental tolerability-review signal not triggered; review documented preferences and side effects, without declaring them absent. Distribution: {TolerabilityReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Discuss tolerability and preference barriers with the clinician; no automatic product switch or dosing advice. Distribution: {TolerabilityReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Established-treatment tolerability cannot be assessed in this context; preferences and treatment discussion remain relevant. Distribution: {TolerabilityReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Experimental safety signal not triggered; this distribution does not certify clinical safety or replace assessment. Distribution: {SafetyAssessmentFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.

A safety assessment review topic is triggered; urgent clinician assessment must follow actual clinical findings, independently of this experimental probability. Distribution: {SafetyAssessmentFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Experimental monitoring-review signal not triggered; this is not certification of completed guideline monitoring. Distribution: {MonitoringReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
Review identified baseline or ongoing monitoring gaps for effectiveness and side effects with the clinician. Distribution: {MonitoringReviewFlag}. DDI remains a separate report.
